title: Yves Saint Laurent Y – Eau de Parfum for Men, 100 ml
short_description: A fresh, woody-amber men's fragrance with a clean, modern and long-lasting character.
description:
Yves Saint Laurent Y Eau de Parfum is a modern, confident fragrance for men. It opens bright and fresh with bergamot, apple and ginger, moves into sage and geranium, and rests on a warm, woody base of amberwood, cedar and vetiver. Long-lasting with moderate sillage.

**Size:** 100 ml

**Concentration:** Eau de Parfum

**Best for:** everyday wear, office, evenings out and gifting. Especially good in autumn and winter.

details.title: How to use
details.body: Spray on pulse points – wrists, neck and behind the ears – from about 15 cm away. Do not rub. Store away from sunlight and heat.

details.title: Shipping and returns
details.body: Express shipping across India. Easy replacement if the product arrives damaged or incorrect.
